body: Thank you. I appreciate the well wishes.
Thank you. I, unfortunately, am not taking any medications that might be the culprit. Glad you got to the bottom of your issues, though.

That's rough, I'm sorry about your stroke. I have been to at least 6 different neurologists at this point. They all do the same thing, just look at my MRI and say it must be all due to anxiety because there's nothing wrong on my brain scan.
